name: Estábulo · Interior
prompt: Precise entrance obstruction removal. Preserve this complete strict-overhead stable floor plan, its outside rectangular walls, centered bottom entrance gap, windows, straw, side furnishings, eight horse stalls, natural wood/earth textures and transparent exterior. There is a wooden post and vertical stall divider DIRECTLY INSIDE the centered bottom doorway, blocking the human's entry path. Remove that center-bottom post and the divider running upward from it into the room; remove its upper end post too if it blocks the center route. Fill their former footprints with the same packed-earth floor. Clear a STRAIGHT unobstructed path from the bottom doorway all the way into the broad central horizontal aisle. This path must stay at least the FULL WIDTH of the actual door opening. Keep stall dividers outside this central entrance lane, and keep the northern stalls and exterior boundary untouched. Do not add another post, door leaf, gate, plank, beam, bread, crate, bench or debris across the entrance corridor. Camera exactly vertical overhead; do not change scale or furniture. No text, labels, grid, people, roof or outside terrain.
